reasons.persona_fit: Speaks directly to the owner-operator in a calm, practical, plain technical voice, preserves human approval boundaries, and adheres strictly to the no-CTA rule.
reasons.clarity: The main point is immediately clear, logically structured, and uses accessible language to explain the operational tradeoffs of rollback planning.
reasons.actionability: Provides a useful diagnostic decision rule and an actionable next step to map manual fallbacks, though keeping it fairly high-level.
reasons.factual_grounding: Strictly within approved boundaries, containing no invented metrics, customer references, or unsupported technical claims.
